lines_of_business.name: Medicare Advantage
lines_of_business.description: Medicare Advantage (Part C), Part D, Cost Plans, PACE, and other CMS contract-based plan benefit packages. Plans in this line of business are identified by a CMS contract ID and plan benefit package number, and are regulated directly by CMS.
lines_of_business.fhir_product_type_notes: Use mediadvhmo where the plan is an HMO. The line of business does not by itself distinguish HMO from other Medicare Advantage product shapes.

lines_of_business.name: Medicaid Managed Care
lines_of_business.description: State Medicaid and CHIP managed care plans. Federally funded but state administered, so applicable mandates vary by state, including whether the state adopted Medicaid expansion.
lines_of_business.fhir_product_type_notes: Use medi for non-managed Medicaid coverage.

lines_of_business.name: Healthcare Marketplace Plans
lines_of_business.description: Qualified Health Plans offered through healthcare.gov or a state-based insurance exchange.

lines_of_business.name: Commercial Plans
lines_of_business.description: Fully insured commercial health insurance regulated primarily at the state level by departments of insurance.
lines_of_business.fhir_product_type_notes: Commercial coverage fans out across commppo, commhmo, commepo, commpos, and commhdhp. The default is a placeholder and should be replaced with the actual product shape wherever it is known.

lines_of_business.name: ERISA Plans
lines_of_business.description: Self-funded employer-sponsored plans governed by the Employee Retirement Income Security Act. The employer bears the insurance risk and a third-party administrator typically processes claims, so the payer entity publishing endpoints may not be the risk-bearing entity.
lines_of_business.fhir_product_type_notes: The HL7 insurance-product-type code system has no code for self-funded ERISA coverage. An explicit product type is required before a conforming NDH InsurancePlan can be produced. See FPI_WellKnown_To_NDH_FHIR_Map.md section 4.1.

lines_of_business.name: Other
lines_of_business.description: Lines of business not covered by the entries above, including TRICARE, Veterans Affairs, Indian Health Service, and Federal Employee Program coverage. This is a holding value and is expected to be decomposed as the corpus grows.
lines_of_business.fhir_product_type_notes: No default is possible. The insurance-product-type code system does carry tri, va, ihs, and fep codes, but the line of business tag is too coarse to select among them.
